title: Elias contests his first game (paraphrase C)
topic: A chess player named Elias plays a tournament game: a knight sacrifice, a long think by the opponent, an arbiter at the next table, the opponent resigns after forty moves
tail_E: When the last round is over Elias is crowned the new tournament
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'champion' is the natural completion of 'is crowned the new tournament' after Elias's adversary throws in the towel and Elias strides from the hall as the game's winner; the word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither do its German equivalents 'Meister' / 'Champion' (unit 10 uses 'winner' / 'Sieger'). ' champion' is a single Pythia token (id 16928). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' champion') = 0.57 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ' winner' 0.17); still rank 1 (p = 0.43) on the K=8 C3 rendering.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV02C, chess player Elias, paraphrase C, development family)
notes: Formulation C: third independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV02A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Elias, wording different from A and B). Replacements include contests his first game of the tournament (bestreitet seine erste Partie des Turniers), adversary plays a pawn move after lengthy deliberation (Widersacher spielt einen Bauernzug nach langem Überlegen), visitors view the game on a huge screen (Besucher sehen die Partie auf einer riesigen Leinwand), gives up a knight in mid-game (gibt einen Springer in der Mitte der Partie - chess usage 'einen Springer geben'), the opponent is lost in thought for twenty minutes (der Gegner ist in Gedanken versunken zwanzig Minuten lang), the fight gets fiercer after the exchange of pieces (der Kampf wird heftiger nach dem Abtausch der Figuren), referee inspects the records at the adjacent table (Offizieller inspiziert die Protokolle am Tisch nebenan - the game score sheets), recognises a powerful move for his rook (erkennt einen mächtigen Zug für seinen Turm), adversary throws in the towel on move forty (Widersacher streckt die Waffen im vierzigsten Zug - both idioms for resigning), strides from the hall as the game's winner (schreitet aus dem Saal als Sieger der Partie). No separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
